name: aidlc-dashboard-v2
description: Read-only web dashboard for an AI-DLC v2 run: status, progress, blockers, timing and usage.
author: Le Bao Duy

scripts.typecheck: bunx tsc -p server --noEmit && bunx tsc -p apps/kirocrew/backend --noEmit && cd web && bunx tsc -b
scripts.lint: bunx --bun @biomejs/biome check server/ scripts/ web/src/ apps/kirocrew/backend/src apps/kirocrew/ui/src
scripts.format: bunx --bun @biomejs/biome format --write server/ scripts/ web/src/ apps/kirocrew/backend/src apps/kirocrew/ui/src
scripts.app:build: bun build apps/kirocrew/backend/src/server.ts --target node --format esm --outfile apps/kirocrew/backend/dist/server.js && bun build apps/kirocrew/ui/src/index.js --target browser --format esm --outfile apps/kirocrew/ui/dist/index.mjs --external react --external react-dom/client --external lucide-react
scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun test && bun run build && bun run app:build && bun run app:test
scripts.app:test: cd apps/kirocrew/backend && bun test && cd ../ui && bun test
